command:
set -eu
echo SSB_METADATA_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
for p in /dev/ssb1 /dev/ssbs1; do
 if test -e "$p"; then stat -c '%n %F %t:%T %u:%g:%a' "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
for c in /sys/class/usbmisc/ssb1 /sys/class/usbmisc/ssbs1; do
 if test -d "$c"; then
  echo "CLASS=$c"
  readlink -f "$c"
  d=$(readlink -f "$c/device")
  echo "DEVICE=$d"
  for l in "$c/device/driver" "$c/device/driver/module"; do
   if test -L "$l"; then echo "$l"; readlink -f "$l"; else echo "NO_SYMLINK $l"; fi
  done
  if test -r "$c/uevent"; then cat "$c/uevent"; fi
  if test -r "$c/device/uevent"; then cat "$c/device/uevent"; fi
  for q in "$d" "$d/.."; do
   for name in idVendor idProduct manufacturer product bcdDevice bInterfaceClass bInterfaceSubClass bInterfaceProtocol; do
    if test -r "$q/$name"; then echo "PROPERTY=$q/$name"; cat "$q/$name"; fi
   done
  done
 else
  echo "ABSENT_CLASS=$c"
 fi
done
echo SSB_METADATA_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: sysfs/device metadata only, no device open/USB command
